name: basic-async-operations-test-5353eae739/async-non-native-basic11-p.bal
spec_references: ## Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"
### Other invocation restrictions: "Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:"
reason: The test requires cancellation of two running futures via f1.cancel() and f2.cancel(), then asserts a panic from waiting on them. Future cancellation is absent from the permitted lang-library methods and method-call list, so start/wait support alone does not place this cancellation-dependent panic behavior in scope.
unsupported_constructs: future cancellation via f1.cancel() and f2.cancel() (lang.future:cancel)
test_design_notes: The @panic assertion concerns execution after cancellation, not merely acceptance of start/wait syntax. runtime:sleep is explicitly supported.
